description: A middle-school counselor must finalize a student's ten-day return-to-school support plan after a prolonged absence, including the daily attendance schedule, physical-education status, academic catch-up load, independent-work window, transportation stop, and implementation record, with input from the student's teacher, school nurse, and family liaison.

shared_context.S1: A seventh-grade student is returning next Monday after missing several weeks of school.
shared_context.S2: The first ten school days will be managed through a written return-to-school support plan.
shared_context.S3: Ms. Brooks signs the plan and coordinates its implementation with teachers, health staff, transportation, and the family.
shared_context.S4: The school's routine case conference requires the homeroom teacher, school nurse, and family liaison to report their operational constraints before Ms. Brooks signs a return plan.

PF1.text: Mr. Ibarra counted 18 missing assignments and determined that the student can safely complete no more than two catch-up assignments per school day, with mathematics and science handled before the other subjects; he completed this review yesterday but has not entered it in the student support tracker.

PF2.text: Nurse Green reviewed the student's physician clearance this morning: for the first ten school days, the student may attend in person only from 8:30 a.m. through 12:00 p.m. and must be excused from physical education; she has not yet attached the clearance to the return-plan record.

PF3.text: Ms. Okafor confirmed with the student's caregiver yesterday that the student must supervise a younger sibling from 12:30 p.m. through 2:30 p.m., can complete independent schoolwork from 3:00 p.m. through 4:00 p.m., and must use the Oak Street bus stop because the caregiver cannot meet the bus at any other stop; she has not updated the transportation and family-support forms.

acceptance_conditions: The student must use a morning in-person attendance plan.
The in-person day must run from 8:30 a.m. through 12:00 p.m.
The student must be excused from physical education during the first ten school days.
The student must receive no more than two catch-up assignments per day.
Mathematics and science must be prioritized before other catch-up subjects.
Independent schoolwork must be scheduled from 3:00 p.m. through 4:00 p.m.
Transportation must use the Oak Street bus stop.
The return plan must include a formal implementation record.

content_checks.C3: 'excused' in decisions['physical_education_status'] and 'first ten school days' in decisions['physical_education_status']
content_checks.C6: '3:00 p.m.' in decisions['independent_work_window'] and '4:00 p.m.' in decisions['independent_work_window']
content_checks.C8: any('return-plan' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The teacher's review changes the catch-up load to exactly two assignments per day and changes the subject order to mathematics and science first.
The physician clearance changes the attendance plan to 8:30 a.m. through 12:00 p.m. in person and changes physical-education status to excused for the first ten school days.
The caregiver confirmation changes the independent-work window to 3:00 p.m. through 4:00 p.m. and changes the transportation assignment to the Oak Street bus stop.
